annotations.title: GitHub repo data: stars, forks, release

description: GitHub repository data in one call: stars, forks, watchers, open issues and pull requests, main language and language shares, topics, license, default branch, created and last-push dates, archived and fork flags, and the latest release with its tag and date. Give owner/name or a github.com URL; public repositories only, no user profile data. Use to vet a dependency, check whether a project is alive, compare libraries or enrich a list of repos. Example: repo=vercel/next.js. Price $0.002/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

owner.description: Owner, only when repo is given as a bare name

repo.description: Repository as owner/name, e.g. vercel/next.js, or its github.com URL
